name: Twin-Headed Snipefish
tooltip:
Twin-Headed Snipefish
5 yd range
3.2 sec cast
Description:
The Twin-Headed Snipefish is a rare fish and has yet to be studied in depth. It's not clear whether this is a new species or a peculiar mutation, but at least one thing is for sure: one head is for aiming and one is for firing.

Areas you can find this fish:
- The Coiled Isle
